main_text.p: זֶךָ tui, זֵיהִי ejus, No. f. & pl. aff. R. זי.

זְמַן, זְמָא, זְמַן tempus, זְמָנִים, זְמַנְיָא tempora, f. & pl. abs. & emph. R. זמן.
זַמְרָא musica, זַמְּרָיָא cantores, No. f. & pl. emph.
R. זמר.

חֲזָיָא visio, חֲזָיֵי ejus, חֶזְוָה visiones, חֲזוֹתָא aspectus ejus, No. f. m. aff. & pl. const.

page.notes: The Hebrew vocalisation and some letters of the upper right and lower columns are read with low certainty and may contain errors; vowel points in particular are not verified. The small mark at the foot of the lower right column (below "const.") is not clearly a signature or catchword and is not transcribed. The running heads are Hebrew letters as printed. The page number "4" is printed at the top left and is partly obscured. Upper left column: "R. זי." and "R. זמן." were read from small type and may be misplaced.
